inputs.title: Key Level

inputs.title: +DI Color

inputs.title: −DI Color
inputs.tooltip: Color of the minus directional indicator, and of the ADX line above the key level while −DI leads.

inputs.title: ATR Line
inputs.tooltip: Color of the ATR line while volatility contracts or holds flat.

inputs.title: Expanding
inputs.tooltip: Color of the ATR line while it rises — volatility expanding bar to bar.

inputs.title: Rising

inputs.title: Falling

inputs.title: Zero Line

inputs.title: BOP Color
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line at exactly zero.

inputs.title: Bullish
inputs.tooltip: Line and fill color while the Balance of Power is above zero — buyers in control of the bar.

inputs.title: Bearish
inputs.tooltip: Line and fill color while the Balance of Power is below zero — sellers in control of the bar.

inputs.tooltip: Number of bars used to calculate the basis SMA and the standard deviation.

inputs.title: Source
inputs.tooltip: Price series the bands are computed from.

inputs.title: Multiplier
inputs.tooltip: Standard deviation multiplier for the upper and lower bands.

inputs.title: Oversold

inputs.title: Bearish
inputs.tooltip: Color of %B below the 0.5 midline, where price trades in the lower half of the bands.

inputs.title: Gradient Fill
inputs.tooltip: Vertical gradient between %B and the 0.5 midline, fully transparent at the midline and more opaque at the oscillator value.

inputs.title: Levels Color
inputs.tooltip: Color of the dashed overbought/oversold levels and of the dotted midline.

inputs.title: Length
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars used for the Bollinger Bands basis (a simple moving average) and for the standard deviation.

inputs.title: Source
inputs.tooltip: Price series the bands are computed from.

inputs.title: Multiplier
inputs.tooltip: Standard deviation multiplier for the upper and lower bands.

inputs.title: Reference Lookback

inputs.title: Show Squeeze Level
inputs.tooltip: Plots the lowest BandWidth of the reference lookback — unusually compressed volatility, a condition rather than a directional signal.

inputs.title: Show Bulge Level
inputs.tooltip: Plots the highest BandWidth of the reference lookback — extreme width that is unlikely to be sustained.

inputs.title: BandWidth
inputs.tooltip: Color of the BandWidth line. At its Squeeze reference the line takes the Squeeze color, at its Bulge reference the Bulge color.

inputs.title: Gradient Fill
inputs.tooltip: Fills the area between zero and BandWidth with a vertical gradient, fully transparent at zero.

inputs.title: Squeeze Level
inputs.tooltip: Color of the lowest-BandWidth reference line.

inputs.title: Bulge Level
inputs.tooltip: Color of the highest-BandWidth reference line.

inputs.tooltip: Line and fill color while momentum is positive, and shading of the oversold zone.

inputs.tooltip: Line and fill color while momentum is negative, and shading of the overbought zone.

inputs.title: Long Stop

inputs.title: Short Stop

inputs.tooltip: Readings below this level indicate a strong trend.

inputs.title: CHOP Line

inputs.title: Choppy
inputs.tooltip: Line, fill and zone color toward and above the upper band — a choppy, range-bound market.

inputs.title: Band Fill
inputs.tooltip: Fill color of the zone between the upper and lower bands.

inputs.title: Length
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars used for the moving average and the mean absolute deviation of the source.

inputs.title: Upper Level

inputs.title: Lower Level

inputs.tooltip: Line and fill color while the CCI reads above zero.

inputs.title: Bearish

inputs.title: RSI Length

inputs.title: Streak RSI Length
inputs.tooltip: Length of the Wilder RSI applied to the up/down close streak.

inputs.title: Percent Rank Length

inputs.title: Overbought Level
inputs.tooltip: Level above which the oscillator is considered overbought.

inputs.title: Oversold Level
inputs.tooltip: Level below which the oscillator is considered oversold.

inputs.title: CRSI Line
inputs.tooltip: Color of the Connors RSI line.

inputs.title: Oversold
inputs.tooltip: Line, fill and zone color toward and below the oversold level.

inputs.title: Overbought
inputs.tooltip: Line, fill and zone color toward and above the overbought level.

inputs.title: Levels
inputs.tooltip: Color of the overbought and oversold levels.

inputs.title: WMA Length
inputs.tooltip: Length of the weighted moving average applied to the sum of the two rates of change.

inputs.title: Long ROC Length
inputs.tooltip: Lookback of the long rate of change, in bars. The original definition uses 14 monthly closes.

inputs.title: Short ROC Length
inputs.tooltip: Lookback of the short rate of change, in bars. The original definition uses 11 monthly closes.

inputs.title: Source
inputs.tooltip: Price series used for the rate of change calculations.

inputs.title: Coppock Curve
inputs.tooltip: Color of the Coppock Curve line.

inputs.title: Bullish
inputs.tooltip: Line and fill color while the curve reads above zero.

inputs.title: Bearish
inputs.tooltip: Line and fill color while the curve reads below zero.

inputs.title: Zero Line
inputs.tooltip: Color of the zero reference line.

inputs.title: Length
inputs.tooltip: Lookback of the simple moving average that price is detrended against. The comparison is displaced by Length / 2 + 1 bars.

inputs.title: Source
inputs.tooltip: Price series used in the detrending calculation.

inputs.title: Centered
inputs.tooltip: Shifts the oscillator back by Length / 2 + 1 bars so it is centered on the prices it detrends. The most recent bars then show no value.

inputs.title: DPO
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line when it sits exactly at zero.

inputs.title: Above Zero
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line and fill while the oscillator is above zero.

inputs.title: Below Zero
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line and fill while the oscillator is below zero.

inputs.title: Zero Line
inputs.tooltip: Color of the zero reference line.

inputs.title: Length
inputs.tooltip: Lookback length. The upper and lower channels are the highest high and lowest low over this many bars.

inputs.title: Upper
inputs.tooltip: Color of the upper channel line.

inputs.title: Middle
inputs.tooltip: Color of the channel midline.

inputs.title: Lower
inputs.tooltip: Color of the lower channel line.

inputs.title: Fill
inputs.tooltip: Color of the channel interior fill.

inputs.title: Length
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars in the simple moving average smoothing the 1-bar Ease of Movement values.

inputs.title: Divisor
inputs.tooltip: Volume scaling constant of the box ratio; larger values scale the oscillator up. 10000 is the conventional default.

inputs.title: EOM Line
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line when it sits exactly at zero.

inputs.title: Above Zero
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line and fill while Ease of Movement is positive.

inputs.title: Below Zero
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line and fill while Ease of Movement is negative.

inputs.title: EMA Length
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars in the exponential moving average of closing prices used as the reference level for Bull Power and Bear Power. Alexander Elder's classic setting is 13.

inputs.title: Bull Power
inputs.tooltip: Color of the Bull Power columns.

inputs.title: Bear Power
inputs.tooltip: Color of the Bear Power columns.

inputs.title: Length
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars used in the EMA calculation.

inputs.title: Source
inputs.tooltip: Price series the EMA is calculated on.

inputs.title: Offset
inputs.tooltip: Bars the plotted line is displaced by. Positive values push it to the right.

inputs.title: Length
inputs.tooltip: Lookback period used to locate the median price hl2 within its highest-lowest range. Ehlers' original length is 10; 9 is the common platform default.

inputs.title: Fisher Line
inputs.tooltip: Color of the Fisher line when it sits exactly on its trigger.

inputs.title: Trigger Line
inputs.tooltip: Color of the trigger line, the Fisher value delayed one bar.

inputs.title: Bullish
inputs.tooltip: Color of the Fisher line and fill while it is above the trigger.

inputs.title: Bearish
inputs.tooltip: Color of the Fisher line and fill while it is below the trigger.

inputs.title: Length
inputs.tooltip: EMA length applied to the raw 1-bar force index, (close − close[1]) × volume. Elder used 13 for the intermediate trend and 2 for short-term timing.

inputs.title: Bullish
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line while above zero (buying pressure).

inputs.title: Bearish
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line while below zero (selling pressure).

inputs.title: Source
inputs.tooltip: Price series fed to the three Alligator averages. Bill Williams' original recipe uses the median price (high + low) / 2.

inputs.title: Smoothing
inputs.tooltip: Moving average applied to the source for the jaw, teeth and lips. The original uses the smoothed (Wilder-style) moving average.

inputs.title: Jaw Length
inputs.tooltip: Averaging length of the jaw line.

inputs.title: Jaw Offset
inputs.tooltip: Bars the jaw is displaced forward, 8 in the original recipe. The upper histogram measures the absolute spread between the displaced jaw and teeth.

inputs.title: Teeth Length
inputs.tooltip: Averaging length of the teeth line.

inputs.title: Teeth Offset
inputs.tooltip: Bars the teeth are displaced forward, 5 in the original recipe. The teeth line enters both spreads.

inputs.title: Lips Length
inputs.tooltip: Averaging length of the lips line.

inputs.title: Lips Offset
inputs.tooltip: Bars the lips are displaced forward, 3 in the original recipe. The lower histogram measures the negative absolute spread between the displaced teeth and lips.

inputs.title: Expanding
inputs.tooltip: Column color while a spread grew against its own previous bar — the averages are spreading apart.

inputs.title: Contracting
inputs.tooltip: Column color while a spread shrank — the averages are converging. Color encodes expansion, not trade direction.

inputs.title: Zero Line
inputs.tooltip: Color of the zero line separating the two histograms.

inputs.title: Length
inputs.tooltip: Lookback window in bars for the standard deviation of close-to-close log returns.

inputs.title: Annualize
inputs.tooltip: Scale the per-bar volatility to an annual figure by multiplying by the square root of the periods per year.

inputs.title: Periods Per Year
inputs.tooltip: Number of periods in a year used for annualization: 252 for daily bars, 52 for weekly, 12 for monthly.

inputs.title: Volatility Line
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line at its recent highs; it fades toward grey as volatility contracts.

inputs.title: Bullish
inputs.tooltip: Color of positive readings, the rising cumulative line and the fill above zero — the accumulation side.

inputs.title: Bearish
inputs.tooltip: Color of negative readings, the falling cumulative line and the fill below zero — the distribution side.

inputs.title: Gradient Fill
inputs.tooltip: Fills the area between the zero line and the oscillator with a vertical gradient. Applies to the normalized oscillator only.

inputs.title: EMA Length
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars used to compute the exponential moving average basis line.

inputs.title: ATR Length
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars used to compute the Average True Range (Wilder smoothing).

inputs.tooltip: ATR multiple used to offset the upper and lower bands from the basis line.

inputs.title: Source
inputs.tooltip: Price series used to compute the basis line.

inputs.tooltip: Bars to step back along each bar's fitted line. 0 plots the line's endpoint at the current bar; larger values read the fit further back, trading lead for smoothness.

inputs.title: Slope Trend Coloring

inputs.title: Line Width

inputs.tooltip: Color of the slope line while the fit is flat.

inputs.tooltip: Fill color of the area between the overbought and oversold levels.

inputs.tooltip: Formula used to calculate the levels. Traditional is the classic floor-trader method; Fibonacci projects 38.2/61.8/100% of the prior range around the pivot; Camarilla scales the prior range around the prior close; Woodie gives extra weight to the period open.

inputs.title: Pivots Timeframe
inputs.tooltip: Period the pivots are anchored to. Auto follows the chart's timeframe: daily pivots up to 15-minute bars, weekly on other intraday bars, monthly on daily bars, yearly above.

inputs.title: Pivot
inputs.tooltip: Color of the central pivot (P) level.

inputs.title: Resistances
inputs.tooltip: Color of the resistance (R) levels.

inputs.title: Supports
inputs.tooltip: Color of the support (S) levels.

inputs.title: Source
inputs.tooltip: Price series whose one-bar percentage change moves PVI on its active sessions.

inputs.title: Starting Value
inputs.tooltip: Seed of the cumulative line. The absolute level carries no information, so the reads are the slope and the position against the signal EMA.

inputs.title: Signal EMA
inputs.tooltip: Plots the long EMA of PVI that anchors the classic regime read. Hiding it keeps the regime coloring and fill, which are always measured against it.

inputs.title: Signal Length
inputs.tooltip: Length of the signal EMA. The classic reference is 255 trading days on daily charts, about one year.

inputs.title: Bullish
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line and gradient fill while it holds above its signal EMA.

inputs.title: Bearish
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line and gradient fill while it holds below its signal EMA.

inputs.title: Neutral
inputs.tooltip: Color used while the signal EMA is still forming, or the line sits exactly on it.

inputs.title: Signal Line
inputs.tooltip: Color of the signal EMA overlay.

inputs.title: Gradient Fill
inputs.tooltip: Fills the gap between the line and its signal EMA with a vertical gradient — transparent at the average, strongest at the line.

inputs.title: Signal Line
inputs.tooltip: Display a moving average of PVT acting as a signal line.

inputs.title: Signal Type
inputs.tooltip: Moving average type used for the signal line.

inputs.title: Signal Length
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars used to compute the signal line.

inputs.title: PVT Color
inputs.tooltip: Color of the PVT line while it is flat.

inputs.title: Rising
inputs.tooltip: Color of the PVT line while it rises bar to bar.

inputs.title: Falling
inputs.tooltip: Color of the PVT line while it falls bar to bar.

inputs.title: Signal Color
inputs.tooltip: Color of the signal line.

inputs.title: Length
inputs.tooltip: Lookback period; the source is compared with its value this many bars ago.

inputs.title: Source
inputs.tooltip: Series used as input for the calculation.

inputs.title: Mode
inputs.tooltip: ROC % plots the change as a percentage of the source value from the lookback; Momentum plots the raw difference.

inputs.title: Line
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line when the reading sits exactly at zero.

inputs.title: Bullish
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line and fill while the reading is above zero.

inputs.title: Bearish
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line and fill while the reading is below zero.

inputs.title: Gradient Fill
inputs.tooltip: Fills the area between the line and zero, following the line color.

inputs.title: Length
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars used in the Wilder smoothing of average gains and losses.

inputs.title: Source
inputs.tooltip: Price series the RSI is calculated on.

inputs.title: Overbought
inputs.tooltip: Level above which the oscillator is considered overbought.

inputs.title: Oversold
inputs.tooltip: Level below which the oscillator is considered oversold.

inputs.title: RSI
inputs.tooltip: Color of the RSI line at the midline. Toward either threshold it blends into that threshold’s color.

inputs.title: Oversold
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line and zone shading at and below the oversold level.

inputs.title: Overbought
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line and zone shading at and above the overbought level.

inputs.title: Levels
inputs.tooltip: Color of the overbought, midline and oversold levels.

inputs.title: Band Fill
inputs.tooltip: Color of the fill between the overbought and oversold levels.

inputs.title: Length
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars summed for the smoothed numerator (close − open) and denominator (high − low).

inputs.title: RVGI
inputs.tooltip: Color of the RVGI line.

inputs.title: Signal
inputs.tooltip: Color of the signal line.

inputs.title: Stdev Length
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars used for the standard deviation of closing prices that serves as each bar's volatility reading.

inputs.title: Smoothing Length
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars used to smooth the up and down volatility streams.

inputs.title: Smoothing Type
inputs.tooltip: Moving average applied to the volatility streams. EMA is Dorsey's classic calculation; Wilder (RMA) matches platforms that use Wilder smoothing.

inputs.title: Overbought Level
inputs.tooltip: Level above which the oscillator is considered overbought.

inputs.title: Oversold Level
inputs.tooltip: Level below which the oscillator is considered oversold.

inputs.title: RVI Line
inputs.tooltip: Color of the RVI line at the midline. Toward either threshold it blends into that threshold’s color.

inputs.title: Overbought
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line and zone shading at and above the overbought level.

inputs.title: Oversold
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line and zone shading at and below the oversold level.

inputs.title: Source
inputs.tooltip: Price series used to build the MACD that the trend cycle is measured on.

inputs.title: Fast Length
inputs.tooltip: Fast EMA length of the underlying MACD.

inputs.title: Slow Length
inputs.tooltip: Slow EMA length of the underlying MACD.

inputs.title: Cycle Length
inputs.tooltip: Window of the two stochastic passes. Each pass measures where its input sits inside the range of its own values over this many bars.

inputs.title: Smoothing Factor
inputs.tooltip: %D style recursive smoothing applied after each stochastic pass. 0.5 is the published default.

inputs.title: Upper Trigger
inputs.tooltip: Upper trigger line. A cross down through it flags an emerging downtrend.

inputs.title: Lower Trigger
inputs.tooltip: Lower trigger line. A cross up through it flags an emerging uptrend.

inputs.title: Bullish Color
inputs.tooltip: Color of the trend cycle line and gradient while the cycle holds the upper half of its 0-100 scale.

inputs.title: Bearish Color
inputs.tooltip: Color of the trend cycle line and gradient while the cycle holds the lower half of its 0-100 scale.

inputs.title: Levels Color
inputs.tooltip: Color of the dashed trigger lines and the dotted midline.

inputs.title: Gradient Fill
inputs.tooltip: Vertical gradient between the midline and the trend cycle, fading out toward the midline.

inputs.title: Length
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars used in the SMA calculation.

inputs.title: Source
inputs.tooltip: Price series the SMA is calculated on.

inputs.title: Offset
inputs.tooltip: Bars the plotted line is displaced by. Positive values push it to the right.

inputs.title: Long Length
inputs.tooltip: Length of the first EMA smoothing applied to the momentum of the closing price.

inputs.title: Short Length
inputs.tooltip: Length of the second EMA smoothing applied to the momentum of the closing price.

inputs.title: Signal Length
inputs.tooltip: Length of the EMA of the SMI that forms the signal line.

inputs.title: Display
inputs.tooltip: Indicator plots the SMI and its signal line. Oscillator plots the difference between them as a histogram.

inputs.title: SMI
inputs.tooltip: Color of the SMI line while it sits exactly on its signal line.

inputs.title: Signal
inputs.tooltip: Color of the signal line.

inputs.title: Oscillator Grow
inputs.tooltip: Color of the rising oscillator histogram, and of the SMI line while it leads its signal.

inputs.title: Oscillator Fall
inputs.tooltip: Color of the falling oscillator histogram, and of the SMI line while it lags its signal.

inputs.title: Source
inputs.tooltip: Price series the average smooths. Wilder computed his 1978 indicators on the close, but the recursion accepts any source.

inputs.title: RMA Length
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars N in Wilder's smoothing: the line keeps (N − 1)/N of its previous value and blends in 1/N of the new price. That alpha is smaller than an EMA's, so an N-period RMA responds like a (2N − 1)-period EMA.

inputs.title: Slope Trend Coloring
inputs.tooltip: Colors the line by its slope — bullish while it rises, bearish while it falls. Disable to draw it in the neutral color.

inputs.title: Line Width
inputs.tooltip: Width of the plotted line, in pixels.

inputs.title: Length
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars used to compute the standard deviation.

inputs.title: Source
inputs.tooltip: Price series the standard deviation is calculated on.

inputs.title: Standard Deviation
inputs.tooltip: Line color while volatility contracts or holds flat.

inputs.title: Expanding
inputs.tooltip: Line and fill color while volatility expands bar to bar.

inputs.title: %K Length
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars used for the highest high / lowest low range of the raw %K.

inputs.title: %K Smoothing
inputs.tooltip: Simple moving average length applied to the raw %K. 1 gives the fast stochastic, 3 the classic slow stochastic.

inputs.title: %D Smoothing
inputs.tooltip: Simple moving average length of the %D signal line, applied to the smoothed %K.

inputs.title: Overbought Level
inputs.tooltip: Level above which the oscillator is considered overbought.

inputs.title: Oversold Level
inputs.tooltip: Level below which the oscillator is considered oversold.

inputs.title: %K
inputs.tooltip: Color of the %K line.

inputs.title: %D
inputs.tooltip: Color of the %D signal line.

inputs.title: Band Fill
inputs.tooltip: Fill color of the area between the overbought and oversold levels.

inputs.title: RSI Source
inputs.tooltip: Price series the RSI is computed on.

inputs.title: RSI Length
inputs.tooltip: Lookback length of the Wilder RSI.

inputs.title: Stochastic Length
inputs.tooltip: Lookback over which the highest and lowest RSI values are taken.

inputs.title: %K Smoothing
inputs.tooltip: Simple moving average length applied to the stochastic of RSI to form %K.

inputs.title: %D Smoothing
inputs.tooltip: Simple moving average length applied to %K to form the %D signal line.

inputs.title: Overbought Level
inputs.tooltip: Level above which the oscillator is considered overbought.

inputs.title: Oversold Level
inputs.tooltip: Level below which the oscillator is considered oversold.

inputs.title: %K Color
inputs.tooltip: Color of the %K line.

inputs.title: %D Color
inputs.tooltip: Color of the %D signal line.

inputs.title: Zone Fill
inputs.tooltip: Fill color of the area between the overbought and oversold levels.

inputs.title: ATR Length
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars used to compute the Wilder ATR.

inputs.title: Factor
inputs.tooltip: ATR multiplier setting how far the trailing stop sits from the bar midpoint.

inputs.title: Uptrend Color
inputs.tooltip: Line color while the trend is up.

inputs.title: Downtrend Color
inputs.tooltip: Line color while the trend is down.

inputs.title: Warning chip in the chart header
Expiry (Pro: all)
inputs.tooltip: Sets the expiry for the IV range and the 0DTE walls. The main call / put wall and zero gamma always use all expiries from 1 to 30 days. The Free plan covers 0DTE.

inputs.title: Length
inputs.tooltip: Length of each of the three EMA smoothing passes applied to the close price.

inputs.title: Signal Length
inputs.tooltip: Length of the EMA applied to TRIX to form the signal line.

inputs.title: TRIX Color
inputs.tooltip: Color of the TRIX line.

inputs.title: Signal Color
inputs.tooltip: Color of the signal line.

inputs.title: Bullish
inputs.tooltip: Color of the TRIX line and its gradient fill while TRIX holds above zero.

inputs.title: Bearish
inputs.tooltip: Color of the TRIX line and its gradient fill while TRIX holds below zero.

inputs.title: Long Length
inputs.tooltip: Length of the first (long) EMA applied to the 1-bar price change.

inputs.title: Short Length
inputs.tooltip: Length of the second (short) EMA applied to the long-smoothed price change.

inputs.title: Signal Length
inputs.tooltip: Length of the EMA of TSI used as the signal line.

inputs.title: TSI
inputs.tooltip: Color of the TSI line.

inputs.title: Signal
inputs.tooltip: Color of the signal line.

inputs.title: Bullish
inputs.tooltip: Color of the TSI line and its gradient fill while TSI holds above zero.

inputs.title: Bearish
inputs.tooltip: Color of the TSI line and its gradient fill while TSI holds below zero.

inputs.title: Length
inputs.tooltip: Shared lookback for the Bollinger Bands, the Keltner Channels, and the momentum regression. John Carter's original setting is 20.

inputs.title: Source
inputs.tooltip: Price series used for the shared moving average basis, the standard deviation, and the momentum displacement.

inputs.title: Bollinger Bands Multiplier
inputs.tooltip: Standard deviation multiplier for the Bollinger Bands.

inputs.title: Keltner Channels Multiplier
inputs.tooltip: ATR multiplier for the Keltner Channels. A smaller multiplier demands a tighter compression before the squeeze turns on.

inputs.title: Momentum Up
inputs.tooltip: Histogram color while momentum is positive. Bars building away from zero print solid, bars fading back print dimmed.

inputs.title: Momentum Down
inputs.tooltip: Histogram color while momentum is negative. Bars building away from zero print solid, bars fading back print dimmed.

inputs.title: Squeeze On
inputs.tooltip: Zero-line dot color while both Bollinger Bands sit fully inside the Keltner Channels.

inputs.title: Squeeze Off
inputs.tooltip: Zero-line dot color while the Bollinger Bands trade outside the Keltner Channels.

inputs.title: Mark Squeeze Fires
inputs.tooltip: Draws a cross on the zero line on the first bar where the bands re-emerge outside the channels, colored by the side of the momentum histogram.

inputs.title: Length
inputs.tooltip: Lookback window. At each bar the percentage drawdown from the window's running maximum is squared; the squares are averaged and the root taken.

inputs.title: Source
inputs.tooltip: Price series the Ulcer Index is computed on. Close is the standard choice.

inputs.title: Stress Threshold
inputs.tooltip: Reference level drawn as a dashed line. The index scales with the instrument's volatility and the window length, so set it relative to its own history.

inputs.title: Ulcer Index
inputs.tooltip: Color of the index near zero; it blends toward the stress color as the reading approaches the threshold.

inputs.title: Stress
inputs.tooltip: Color of the index at and beyond the stress threshold.

inputs.title: Gradient Fill
inputs.tooltip: Vertical gradient between zero and the Ulcer Index, fully transparent at zero.

inputs.title: Drawdown %
inputs.tooltip: Plot the current percentage drawdown from the window high as columns below zero — the raw ingredient the index averages.

inputs.title: Drawdown Color
inputs.tooltip: Color of the drawdown columns.

inputs.title: Threshold
inputs.tooltip: Color of the stress threshold line.

inputs.title: Fast Length
inputs.tooltip: Bars in the fastest averaging window. Weighted 4 in the final blend, so it dominates the oscillator.

inputs.title: Middle Length
inputs.tooltip: Bars in the intermediate averaging window. Weighted 2 in the final blend.

inputs.title: Slow Length
inputs.tooltip: Bars in the slowest averaging window. Weighted 1 in the final blend.

inputs.title: Overbought
inputs.tooltip: Level above which the oscillator is considered overbought.

inputs.title: Oversold
inputs.tooltip: Level below which the oscillator is considered oversold.

inputs.title: Oscillator
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line midway between the levels. Toward either level it blends into that level’s color.

inputs.title: Levels
inputs.tooltip: Color of the overbought and oversold levels.

inputs.title: Oversold
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line at the oversold level and of the oversold zone shading.

inputs.title: Overbought
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line at the overbought level and of the overbought zone shading.

inputs.title: Source
inputs.tooltip: Price series the average smooths. VIDYA is classically computed on the close.

inputs.title: VIDYA Length
inputs.tooltip: EMA-equivalent length N of the base smoothing constant, alpha = 2 / (N + 1). The adaptive scaler rescales this base speed bar by bar.

inputs.title: Adaptive Scaler
inputs.tooltip: Bar-by-bar measure that rescales the smoothing constant. Momentum divides the absolute Chande Momentum Oscillator by 100; Volatility is Chande's original short-term over reference standard deviation.

inputs.title: Scaler Lookback
inputs.tooltip: Lookback of the adaptive scaler — the CMO period in momentum mode, or the short-term standard deviation window in volatility mode.

inputs.title: Reference StDev Length
inputs.tooltip: Volatility mode only — window of the reference standard deviation the short-term reading is divided by.

inputs.title: Flat Threshold
inputs.tooltip: One-bar change of VIDYA, as a fraction of ATR, below which the line reads as flat.

inputs.title: ATR Normalization Length
inputs.tooltip: ATR window used to normalize VIDYA's one-bar slope, so the flat threshold behaves consistently across symbols and timeframes.

inputs.title: Trend Regime Coloring
inputs.tooltip: Colors VIDYA by its regime read — bullish while sloping up beyond the flat threshold, bearish while sloping down, flat inside congestion.

inputs.title: Adaptive Gradient
inputs.tooltip: Blends the trend color toward the flat color according to the adaptive scaler, so the line pales as momentum dies.

inputs.title: Line Width
inputs.tooltip: Width of the plotted line, in pixels.

inputs.title: Length
inputs.tooltip: Rolling summation window, also used for the average volume that scales the result. The published default of 130 bars targets position-horizon work on daily charts.

inputs.title: Cutoff Coefficient
inputs.tooltip: Scales the volatility-based minimum change in typical price. Moves smaller than the cutoff count as noise and contribute no volume.

inputs.title: Volume Cap Multiplier
inputs.tooltip: Caps each bar's volume contribution at this multiple of the average volume, so a single climactic print stays bounded.

inputs.title: Volatility Length
inputs.tooltip: Window of the standard deviation of the log change in typical price used to build the adaptive cutoff.

inputs.title: Smooth VFI
inputs.tooltip: Applies the published light smoothing — an EMA of the summed line — before plotting.

inputs.title: Smoothing Length
inputs.tooltip: Length of the smoothing EMA. The published version uses 3 bars.

inputs.title: Signal Line
inputs.tooltip: Plots an EMA of VFI as a signal line.

inputs.title: Signal Length
inputs.tooltip: Length of the signal-line EMA.

inputs.title: Bullish
inputs.tooltip: Color of the VFI line and gradient fill above the zero line — the net accumulation regime.

inputs.title: Bearish
inputs.tooltip: Color of the VFI line and gradient fill below the zero line — the net distribution regime.

inputs.title: Signal Line
inputs.tooltip: Color of the signal line.

inputs.title: Gradient Fill
inputs.tooltip: Fills the area between the zero line and the VFI line with a vertical gradient.

inputs.title: Fast Length
inputs.tooltip: Length of the fast EMA of volume.

inputs.title: Slow Length
inputs.tooltip: Length of the slow EMA of volume.

inputs.title: Above Zero
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line and fill while it holds above zero — volume expanding.

inputs.title: Below Zero
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line and fill while it holds below zero — volume contracting.

inputs.title: Length
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars used to sum the vortex movements (VM+ and VM−) and the true range.

inputs.title: VI+
inputs.tooltip: Color of the positive vortex line (VI+).

inputs.title: VI−
inputs.tooltip: Color of the negative vortex line (VI−).

inputs.title: Baseline
inputs.tooltip: Color of the dotted baseline drawn at 1.

inputs.title: Length
inputs.tooltip: Lookback length of the highest high / lowest low range. 14 is the classic setting.

inputs.title: Source
inputs.tooltip: Series located within the lookback range. Close is the classic choice.

inputs.title: Overbought Level
inputs.tooltip: Level above which the oscillator is considered overbought.

inputs.title: Oversold Level
inputs.tooltip: Level below which the oscillator is considered oversold.

inputs.title: %R Line
inputs.tooltip: Color of the %R line between the levels. Toward either level it blends into that level’s color.

inputs.title: Overbought
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line and zone shading at and above the overbought level.

inputs.title: Oversold
inputs.tooltip: Color of the line and zone shading at and below the oversold level.

inputs.title: Jaw Length
inputs.tooltip: Smoothing length of the Jaw SMMA of median price (hl2), 13 in the classic setup.

inputs.title: Teeth Length
inputs.tooltip: Smoothing length of the Teeth SMMA of median price (hl2), 8 in the classic setup.

inputs.title: Lips Length
inputs.tooltip: Smoothing length of the Lips SMMA of median price (hl2), 5 in the classic setup.

inputs.title: Jaw Offset
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars the Jaw plot is shifted into the future, 8 in the classic setup.

inputs.title: Teeth Offset
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars the Teeth plot is shifted into the future, 5 in the classic setup.

inputs.title: Lips Offset
inputs.tooltip: Number of bars the Lips plot is shifted into the future, 3 in the classic setup.

inputs.title: Jaw
inputs.tooltip: Color of the Jaw line.

inputs.title: Teeth
inputs.tooltip: Color of the Teeth line.

inputs.title: Lips
inputs.tooltip: Color of the Lips line.

inputs.title: Periods
inputs.tooltip: Bars required on each side of the candidate bar. 2 is Bill Williams' classic 5-bar fractal; a fractal is confirmed only once this many later bars have closed.

inputs.title: Up Fractal
inputs.tooltip: Color of the up fractal marker (swing high), drawn above the fractal bar.

inputs.title: Down Fractal
inputs.tooltip: Color of the down fractal marker (swing low), drawn below the fractal bar.

inputs.title: Source
inputs.tooltip: Price series the average de-lags and then smooths.

inputs.title: ZLEMA Length
inputs.tooltip: EMA length N. It sets both the smoothing (alpha = 2 / (N + 1)) and the correction: an EMA of length N lags by about (N − 1)/2 bars, and the de-lagging step is sized to cancel exactly that.

inputs.title: Slope Trend Coloring
inputs.tooltip: Colors the line by its slope — bullish while it rises, bearish while it falls. Disable to draw it in the neutral color.

inputs.title: Line Width
inputs.tooltip: Width of the plotted line, in pixels.

inputs.title: Deviation (%)
inputs.tooltip: Minimum reversal from the leg extreme, as a percentage of that extreme, required to confirm a new pivot.

inputs.title: Depth
inputs.tooltip: Minimum number of bars required between two consecutive pivots.

inputs.title: Up Leg
inputs.tooltip: Color of rising zigzag segments.

inputs.title: Down Leg
inputs.tooltip: Color of falling zigzag segments.

inputs.title: Width
inputs.tooltip: Width of the zigzag segments.
